When Russell came home, he was calm, happy, and had a great appetite. It was obvious that he had been well cared for with love and attention. We are very happy with this boarding facility and highly recommend it.

I want to thank Joe and his team for taking care of my Jackie. It was the first time so I was an anxious pet mom but he sent me pics/videos and I could see she was in good spirits and happy. After we returned to pick her up, I got a follow-up to check on her settling back in at home. Without a doubt if the occasion arises, I would have Jackie stay with them again. Thank you again 🙏🏼

I’m really disappointed with my experience here. I brought my cat in for grooming (de-shedding, teeth cleaning, and ear cleaning), but when I got home and checked her, it didn’t seem like much had been done.

She still had a noticeable amount of loose fur, which is especially frustrating because I recently developed an allergy and was relying on this service. I ended up de-shedding her myself at home, and the amount of fur I was able to remove afterward is shown in the photo—it’s hard to understand what was actually done during the appointment. I also noticed plaque still present on her teeth, so I ended up cleaning them myself as well.

I did call them after noticing this, and they told me they had removed a lot of fur and offered for me to bring her back to continue de-shedding free of charge. While I appreciate the offer, it doesn’t really address why it wasn’t done properly the first time or why there was still so much fur left.

Overall, it felt like a waste of time and money. I had higher expectations and left pretty disappointed. Maybe they’re better with dogs, but based on my experience, I wouldn’t recommend them for cats.
